ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity white central pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels located along the peripheral borders and central base.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central areas of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a solid band along the lateral and trailing edges. A distinct dark circular focal point is located on the inner-lower region of the right lobe (image right). Dark mottling is present near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a narrow pixel-angle at the vertex and high vertical depth relative to the horizontal span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by small, sharp peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A prominent dark circular pixel cluster is located on the interior white surface of the right lobe. Smaller dark clusters are visible at the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark linear pixel disruption (scratch) is visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the trailing edge towards the central part of the fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Detection of a localized, high-texture reddish-brown cluster of biological material (likely ectoparasites) attached to the distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of a prominent reddish biological colony on the left tip serves as a unique visual identifier.
